label: Minimum Painting Project — Small Intervention
research_anchor: Painter setup costs (travel, protection, masking, tool preparation, mixing, cleanup) cannot be diluted over tiny surfaces. Mano.ma and travauxpeinture.ma implicitly require project scope. At 35 DH/m² labour and minimum 2–3 painter hours (300–450 DH labour) plus travel, materials and overhead, a rational minimum project is 600–1200 MAD.
complexity_escape_rules: If prepared surface exceeds 8–10m², move to standard m² service
If wall preparation is required, add preparation surcharge

label: Interior Wall — Labour Only (client supplies paint)
label_fr: Peinture mur intérieur — main d'œuvre seule (peinture fournie par client)
research_anchor: EV-001 (Mano.ma): 25–40 DH/m² labour only national average. EV-008 (Mano.ma Casablanca): 35–50 DH/m². EV-012 (Mano.ma Fès): 22–36 DH/m². Evidence well-corroborated across platforms. Scope: light surface preparation (small cracks, light sanding), primer application, 2 coats of client-supplied paint.
scope_inclusions: Light surface preparation (small holes, light sanding)
complexity_escape_rules: Significant wall preparation required → PEIN-005 or separate quote
Active moisture/mold → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE, refer to Plomberie/Maçonnerie
Structural cracks → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE, refer to Maçonnerie
Height >3m → scaffolding surcharge required
Color change dark-to-light → may require 3rd coat surcharge

label: Interior Wall — Labour + Standard Paint Included
label_fr: Peinture mur intérieur — main d'œuvre + peinture standard incluse
research_anchor: EV-002 (Mano.ma): 60–100 DH/m² all-in standard. EV-019 (Bnidari vinyl mate 25–40 DH all-in — economy). EV-020 (Bnidari satin lavable 45–75 DH all-in). EV-022 (Bnidari platform average 30–80). EV-023 (travauxpeinture.ma 25–60 DH all-in, measurement basis unknown). 45–80 DH/m² range uses standard-quality paint (Astral, Colorado, Atlas). Paint quality tier: standard acrylic/vinyl washable.
scope_exclusions: Enduit de lissage (quoted separately if needed)
complexity_escape_rules: Active moisture → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE
Structural cracks → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE
Major peeling/stripping required → surcharge or separate quote
Dark-to-light color change → 3rd coat discussion required

label: Ceiling — Standard Repaint (labour + paint)
label_fr: Peinture plafond standard (main d'œuvre + peinture incluse)
research_anchor: EV-005 (Mano.ma MO only 20–35 DH/m²) + EV-015/016 (Mano.ma ceiling guide: MO only 40–80; all-in 60–150). EV-026 (Mondevis.ma 2015: 20–32 DH — inflated to ~30–50 DH by 2026). Ceiling measurement basis: PAINTED_SURFACE_M2 = ceiling area (which equals room floor area). Note: Moroccan ceilings often require enduit de lissage (béton brut) — if included, the 60–100 range is realistic; if excluded, 40–80.
scope_inclusions: 2 coats white or light color paint
scope_exclusions: Enduit de lissage (often required separately — see PEIN-008)
complexity_escape_rules: Moisture stains → requires moisture source diagnosis first
Ceiling height >3m → scaffolding surcharge
Major cracks → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE Maçonnerie

label: Interior Wall — With Minor Preparation (rebouchage + enduit local)
label_fr: Peinture mur intérieur avec préparation légère (rebouchage, ponçage, enduit local)
research_anchor: Derived from: PEIN-003 base (45–80 DH) + EV-032 enduit supplement (20–40 DH/m²) = 65–120 DH/m². EV-007 (Mano.ma primer surcharge 8–15). Mano.ma notes fissures fines: +rebouchage 5–15 DH/m². Confidence MEDIUM because no direct single-source evidence for this combined scope; derived from component evidence.
scope_inclusions: Rebouchage of small holes and minor cracks
scope_exclusions: Full enduit de lissage over entire surface
Stripping of heavily deteriorated old paint
complexity_escape_rules: If more than 20% of surface requires enduit → full enduit scope (PEIN-006 or quote)
Active moisture → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE
Structural cracking → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE

label: Full Room Repaint — Standard (walls + ceiling, ready condition)
label_fr: Peinture pièce complète — murs + plafond, état standard
research_anchor: Derived from Fixeo pSEO page (T0 context only): 1400–2800 MAD per pièce (20m²). Cross-check: 20m² room floor area => painted walls ~45m² (4 walls, 2.7m ceiling) + 20m² ceiling = 65m² painted. At 45–60 DH/m² all-in: 65 × 52 ≈ 3380 MAD. At 35 DH/m² MO only: 65 × 35 ≈ 2275. Reddit EV-029: 100m² floor apartment = 17,000 DH / 4–5 rooms ≈ 3400–4250 per room (premium brand). Range 1200–2800 represents standard to mid-quality scope.
complexity_escape_rules: If surface condition is MODERATE_REPAIR or worse → quote required
If decorative finish requested → PEIN-010 or quote
If room is very large (>25m² floor) → per-m² pricing more appropriate

label: Full Apartment Repaint Package — F2/F3 ~60–80m² floor area
label_fr: Rénovation peinture complète appartement F2/F3 (60–80m² surface plancher)
research_anchor: EV-013 (Mano.ma 100m² painted surface MO only: 2500–4000 DH). EV-014 (Mano.ma 100m² painted surface all-in standard: 9000–13000 DH). Simulation: F2/F3 at 70m² floor area has approx 154m² painted walls + 70m² ceiling = 224m² painted surface. At 25–40 DH/m² MO: 5600–8960. At 45–75 DH/m² all-in: 10080–16800. Reddit EV-029: 17,000 DH for 100m² floor (premium brands). Range 5000–12000 covers MO-only to standard all-in for F2/F3.
complexity_escape_rules: If significant preparation required throughout → quote required
Occupied property → discuss timeline and furniture access

label: Enduit de Lissage — Surface Preparation Only
label_fr: Enduit de lissage / skim coat (préparation surface)
research_anchor: EV-032 (Mano.ma: 20–40 DH/m² supplement for enduit de lissage). EV-017 (Mano.ma ceiling with enduit: 80–180 DH all-in vs 60–150 without — delta ≈ 20–30 DH/m²). Mano.ma notes enduit often required on béton brut surfaces common in Morocco. This is a prerequisite for quality painting on many Moroccan surfaces.
scope_inclusions: Surface ready for primer and paint
complexity_escape_rules: Structural damage → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE Maçonnerie
Moisture substrate → treat source first

label: Interior Door Painting (wood)
research_anchor: No strong Moroccan-specific source found for door painting per unit. Extrapolated from European benchmarks (40–90€/door ≈ 440–990 MAD) adjusted for Moroccan labour rates. At 35 DH/m² and ~4m² per door side (both sides) ≈ 140–280 DH labour only. With paint: 150–400 MAD range. CONFIDENCE LOW — limited direct Moroccan evidence.
complexity_escape_rules: Significant wood damage → Menuiserie scope
Metal door → different scope, see PEIN-011

label: Decorative Finishes — Tadelakt, Stucco, Béton Ciré
label_fr: Finitions décoratives (tadelakt, stucco, béton ciré, yakout)
research_anchor: EV-021 (Bnidari: 80–180 DH/m² decorative yakout/ambra). EV-024 (travauxpeinture.ma: tadelakt 300–600 DH/m²). EV-004 (Mano.ma: tadelakt/béton ciré 150–350 DH/m²). Mano.ma stucco/badigeons 100–200 DH/m². Extremely wide range, artisan skill-dependent. QUOTE_REQUIRED for FIXEO.
complexity_escape_rules: Always QUOTE_REQUIRED — artisan evaluation mandatory

label: Exterior Facade Painting
research_anchor: EV-003 (Mano.ma all-in 80–130 DH/m²). EV-009 (Mano.ma Casablanca MO only 50–70 DH/m²). EV-027 (Public procurement 68 DH/m² 2 coats plastic paint all-in). Mano.ma: 35–55 DH/m² labour only nationally. Facade is complex: access, scaffolding (which may double the cost), crack treatment, UV paint, weather conditions. QUOTE_REQUIRED for FIXEO V1.
complexity_escape_rules: Scaffolding required → quote mandatory
More than 1 floor height → quote mandatory
Structural cracks → Maçonnerie first
Active infiltration → Toiture/Plomberie first

label: Heavy Wall Repair — Major Plaster / Extensive Enduit
label_fr: Réparation mur lourde (plâtre, enduit étendu, maçonnerie légère)
research_anchor: No direct Moroccan evidence found for heavy plaster repair pricing. Insufficient evidence for standardized price. Requires artisan assessment. May cross into Maçonnerie scope.
complexity_escape_rules: Structural damage → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE Maçonnerie
Always QUOTE_REQUIRED
